description: Lightning-family projectile proof: select Aero Thunder, spawn stationary test mobs, cast the crosshair lightning projectile Smite, and clean up.
notes: Smite is the Thunder style's authored projectile; Chain Lightning is a separate chain-hop runtime and is intentionally not asserted by this projectile-only scenario.
The runner checks smite's ability_cast_end because it is listed in abilities; projectile_impact_resolved is the server-side resolution evidence.
server-truth:snapshot asserts snapshot presence only; this scenario does not claim a visual screenshot or log-gate result.
